name: E2EDevBench
description: E2EDevBench is an end-to-end software development benchmark constructed from 50 recent, high-quality PyPI projects. Each project averages 19.2 source files, 2,011.5 lines of code, and 119.7 test cases, providing a realistic testbed for evaluating autonomous LLM-based development agents.
reputation: Addresses limitations of simpler coding benchmarks by testing full end-to-end project development
notes: SOTA agents fulfill approximately 50% of requirements; primary bottleneck is requirement omission and inadequate self-verification; uses hybrid evaluation combining test-case-based functional assessment with LLM-based requirement verification.
